_comment: LILYGO T3-S3 (ESP32-S3 + SX1280 2.4GHz) hardware layout for the ELRS Ghost/Sniffer RX.
_comment_pins: Pins verified against LilyGo T3-S3 SX1280 community docs. VERIFY the RF-switch / PA lines against YOUR board revision (v1.0 non-PA vs v1.2 'H658' PA) before trusting RX sensitivity.
_comment_usage: This is the ELRS unified-firmware hardware layout. Flash it into the RX config partition (see docs/02_build_flash_guide.md). Alternatively use firmware/target/T3S3_Sniffer_RX.h for a compile-time build.
product_name: LILYGO T3S3 ELRS Telemetry Sniffer RX
_comment_serial: No serial_rx/serial_tx on purpose: a sniffer has no flight controller. Omitting them makes ELRS use a no-op FC serial (SerialNOOP) instead of endlessly trying to auto-detect an FC baud rate (unsupported on S3 -> log spam). Debug/telemetry still route to USBSerial via DEBUG_LOG.
_comment_rfsw: T3-S3 SX1280 PA/FEM RF switch. Rev 1.1/1.2 (H658 PA) route the RX/TX enable to GPIO21 (RXEN) and GPIO10 (TXEN). ELRS drives RXEN HIGH during receive (RFAMP_hal). Without these the LNA path is never enabled and the radio is deaf even though SPI init succeeds. If you have a true bare-SX1280 v1.0 with no FEM, remove these two keys.
_comment_power: Receive-only: we never key TX. Bounds kept conservative regardless.
_comment_screen: The 0.96in SSD1306 OLED (I2C, SDA=18 SCL=17) is driven directly by devGhostDisplay.cpp, NOT by the ELRS screen system, so no screen_* keys here (avoids I2C contention).
_comment_led: Onboard LED / addressable LED pin varies by rev; adjust or remove.
